purpose: Measure the user-visible latency of the public Gekta assistant on the exact deployed production revision, so the P0 SPEED gate of the Gekta final unified completion specification can be accepted or rejected on evidence instead of estimate. This scope covers measurement instrumentation only: a baseline tool that reads the same SSE stream a browser consumes, its unit tests, and an owner-triggered read-only workflow that runs it against the public production endpoint. No runtime, model, gateway or request-path behaviour is changed by this scope.
concurrencyBoundary: This scope is additive and must never modify, reorder, pause or reinterpret allowedCurrentScope. IR-10.4 settlement remains the current step and its files are outside this scope.
requiredBehavior: run the production baseline only from an owner-authorized workflow_dispatch, never automatically and never on push
measure only the public production HTTPS endpoint https://процент-агро.рф and its published SSE path /api/agro-chat?stream=1
record the repository main SHA, the deployed API revision, the deployed Web revision and the measurement time before any request is issued
publish the run as an exact-main baseline only when the deployed API and Web revisions are actually proven; otherwise publish it as an unattested network measurement
separate headersMs, firstTokenMs, firstMeaningfulTextMs and completedMs, because the P0 SPEED gate is stated in terms of first meaningful text rather than the first frame of any kind
keep failed requests out of the latency percentiles and report them as error classes, so a timeout cannot be read as a slow success
report null and exit non-zero when nothing completed, rather than emitting a fabricated baseline
keep single-turn percentiles separate from multi-turn, correction and topic-shift latency
raise concurrency only through bounded read-only waves with a cooldown between them, and stop escalating when a wave shows overload
forbiddenCapabilities: any SSH access to the REG.RU virtual server
any production secret, credential, token or database URL in the workflow
any deploy, image build, container, Compose, Caddy or DNS mutation
any database read, write or migration
any change to the AI gateway, Qwen runtime settings, model parameters or request path
any change to settlement, registration, authentication, RLS, MFA or audit behaviour
any write request against production, including registration, login or deal actions
raising a timeout, weakening semantic acceptance, dropping difficult questions, dropping RU/EN/ZH coverage or disabling context in order to improve a measured number
presenting a measurement taken against an unproven revision as an exact-main baseline
acceptance: the baseline tool is unit tested without contacting any network endpoint
the workflow runs on a github-hosted runner with no repository secrets beyond the default token
a completed run publishes a bounded JSON artifact containing percentiles, error classes, revision evidence and per-class breakdown
no file outside allowedPaths is changed by this scope
